definitions.explanation: An organization that has joined a larger federation, league, or alliance as a member.

examples.japanese: {加盟団体|かめいだんたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of member organizations increased.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧{加盟団体|かめいだんたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Representatives of each member organization gathered.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{連盟|れんめい}→連盟：23112_renmei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧{加盟団体|かめいだんたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{参加|さんか}している→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: This federation has over a hundred member organizations participating from across the country.

notes:
Written ⟦{加盟|かめい}→加盟：05769_kamei⟧ (joining, affiliation) + ⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧ (organization, body). Common in contexts involving leagues, federations, and international bodies.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{加盟国|かめいこく}→加盟国：19160_kameikoku⟧: member nation — the same ⟦{加盟|かめい}→加盟：05769_kamei⟧ applied to countries (e.g. of the UN)
- ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧: member — refers to an individual member rather than an organization
